title: Bank staff queue
description: One snapshot page of the read-only bank-staff queue: the pending requests the Basetool's staff queue shows the member, and those waiting for the member's approval, both oldest first. Decided anew on every call. Foreign bank data: a client keeps it in memory only, for at most 7 days.

oldestOpenAt.description: When the oldest request in either section was raised; null when both are empty.

oldestOverdue.description: Whether that request is 48 hours old or older.

open.description: The pending requests of the Basetool's staff queue: the granted accounts for a bank employee, the whole bank for the Bankleitung.

toApprove.description: The pending requests that wait for the member's approval, exactly those that carry an approval-needed notice for the member.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page of both sections; null after the last one.

item.description: One pending booking request: no staff note, no holder fields, no custody balances and no handle but the requester's.

id.description: Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

amount.description: The requested amount in whole aUEC.

ageHours.description: The whole hours since the request was raised.

account.description: The account the request debits, or credits for a deposit.

orgUnitShorthand.description: The owning org unit's short label; null for an account without one.

targetAccount.description: The destination of a transfer; null otherwise.

requesterHandle.description: The requester's handle; null when they withhold their name from connected applications.

justification.description: The justification as plain text; null when none was given.

note.description: The requester's note as plain text; null when none was given.

requiresOwnerApproval.description: Whether the request is over the requester's limit and needs an approval.

requiredApprover.description: Who must approve it; null when no approval is needed.

ownerApprovalGranted.description: Whether the approval was given in the Basetool.

mayConfirm.description: Whether the member's bank rights cover this request type on the account and the member did not raise it. Confirming stays in the Basetool.

accountBalance.description: The account's balance in whole aUEC for the Bankleitung and for an employee granted on the account; null otherwise.

client.description: The registry id of the connected application that raised the request; null when it was raised in the Basetool or the origin is not recorded.

link.description: Opens this request in the Basetool.
